summary.zh-CN: 从读者任务写出标题、提纲、证据需求与写作验收。
summary.en: Build a page brief with intent, outline, evidence needs and content acceptance.

inputs.zh-CN: 机会卡、读者任务、第一手材料、现有页面
inputs.en: Opportunity card, reader task, original evidence and existing pages

outputs.zh-CN: 页面 brief JSON；交给内容制作的清单
outputs.en: Page brief and a production handoff

safety.zh-CN: 默认只读与本地产物；不自动修改生产、提交索引或外发。
safety.en: Read-only analysis and local artifacts by default; no automatic production changes, indexing submission or outreach.

prompt.zh-CN: 请使用 $seo-page-brief，仅分析我提供或已授权读取的资料。先检查必要输入，未知数据保留未知，按 Skill 模板交付并列出验收结果；不要自动发布。
prompt.en: Use $seo-page-brief to analyze only supplied or authorized materials. Check required inputs, preserve unknowns, deliver the skill template and acceptance results, and do not publish automatically.
